description.narrative:
Impact: Afghan women and girls have their human rights protected and promoted through access to essential services, humanitarian assistance, livelihoods and income opportunities, improved voice and agency and support from a resilient Afghan women's movement.
OUTCOME 1.1 By the end of 2025, more people in Afghanistan, particularly the most marginalized, will be able to equitably access essential services that meet minimum quality standards.
OUTCOME 1.2 By the end of 2025, more people in Afghanistan, notably women and vulnerable groups, will benefit from an increasingly inclusive economy, with greater equality of economic opportunities, jobs, more resilient livelihoods, strengthened food value chains, and improved natural resources management.
OUTCOME 1.3 By the end of 2025, more people in Afghanistan can participate in an increasingly socially cohesive, gender equal, and inclusive society, where the rule of law and human rights are progressively upheld, and more people can participate in governance and decision-making.
Outcome 1.4: By end of 2025, the UN system in Afghanistan, Member States and regional organizations effectively contribute to progress on gender equality and the empowerment of women and girls in Afghanistan.

Insatsen fokuserar på att skydda och främja afghanska kvinnor och flickors mänskliga rättigheter genom tillgång till nödvändig service, humanitärt bistånd, försörjning och inkomstmöjligheter, möjligheter att delta och göra sina röster hörda samt en motståndskraftig afghansk kvinnorörelse.

The contribution is aiming to protect and promote Afghan women and girls human rights through access to essential services, humanitarian assistance, livelihoods and income opportunities, improved voice and agency and support from a resilient Afghan women's movement.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions
